aliases: Things to consider while selecting training venue

one_line_answer.text: Consider location, cost, facilities, objectives, a site visit and fit when selecting a venue.

cites.quote: Things to consider while selecting training venue • Location • Cost of the venue • The Facilities available • Meet Objectives • Make a Site Visit • Fit for Purpose • Building a Good Relationship with the venue staff
Things to consider while selecting training venue

keywords.bn: কাজের উপযোগী, যেমন room-এর সঠিক size

bangla_explanation: Training venue বাছাই করার সময় location, cost আর facilities দেখুন।
আগে site visit করুন, শুধু ছবি দেখে venue ঠিক করবেন না।
Room-এর size learners সংখ্যার সাথে মিলছে কিনা দেখুন, একে fit for purpose বলে।
Venue staff-এর সাথে good relationship রাখুন, তাহলে চা-নাস্তা নিয়ে চিন্তা কম।

example.en: A driving theory class has 25 trainees. The trainer visits a hall near the bus stand. He checks parking, sound and room size.
example.bn: Bus stand-এর কাছে হলে সবার আসা সহজ: এটাই location বিবেচনা।

items.text: The Right Fit: the venue suits the type of event and impression.

cites.quote: The Right Fit
The venue has to be harmonious with the type of event you are running and the impression you want to create.

items.text: Location: consider how easy it is to get to for attendees.

cites.quote: Location is one of the most important factors things when choosing training venues.
You should always consider how easy it is to get to for your attendees.

items.text: Cost: a fixed price including everything you are likely to need.

cites.quote: A good venue will make things straightforward and offer a fixed price including everything you are likely to need

items.text: The Facilities: always look at them before you book.

cites.quote: The Facilities
Always look at the facilities in a venue before you book.

items.text: Your Objectives: be clear on your objectives at the start.

cites.quote: Your Objectives Be clear on what your objectives are at the start.

items.text: Make a Site Visit: see the venue and decide whether it fits your requirements.

cites.quote: Make a Site Visit
Site visits are important because they give you a chance to see the venue and decide whether it will fit your requirements.

items.text: Fit for Purpose: right size for the learners and room set up style.

cites.quote: Fit for Purpose
Make sure it is the right size for the proposed number of learners and can accommodate your room set up style

items.text: Building a Good Relationship with the venue staff.

cites.quote: Building a Good Relationship
are the venue staff nice people who you feel you can build a good relationship with?

traps.text: The answer key lists Location, Cost, Facilities, Objectives, Site Visit, Fit for Purpose, Relationship.

short.prompt: What are the things you need to consider while selecting a training venue?
short.modelAnswer:
Things to consider while selecting a training venue:
1. The right fit for the event
2. Location
3. Cost of the venue
4. The facilities available
5. Meet your objectives
6. Make a site visit
7. Fit for purpose
8. Building a good relationship with the venue staff

keyPoints.text: Check facilities: meeting room, sound system, disabled access, blackout windows.

cites.quote: Does it have a meeting room?
Does it have a suitable sound system?
Is there disabled access?
Do windows have blackout capability?

keyPoints.text: Check public transport links and plenty of car parking.

cites.quote: Are you close enough to public transport links
it is vital to assess whether there is plenty of car parking.

keyPoints.text: Make a note of what you want from the venue before the site visit.

cites.quote: make a note of what you want from the venue a few days before you go to view it.

options: To see the venue and decide whether it fits your requirements
